messages:
alex: FYI customer on dedicated reported a 400 ValidationError during tool calling. They call our OpenAI-compatible endpoint and get a schema enum mismatch. Blocking their QA >:(

sophie: Can you paste the original request + the error body?

alex: Pasted minimal repro below. Note the model returned a boolean for `mode` where the tool spec expects an enum string.

alex: ```http
POST /v1/chat/completions -> our gateway
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "model": "redwood/agent-1",
  "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "set search mode to fastest" }],
  "functions": [
    {"name": "set_search_mode", "parameters": {"type": "object", "properties": {"query": {"type": "string"}, "mode": {"type": "string", "enum": ["fast", "accurate"]}}, "required": ["query", "mode"]}}
  ]
}

-- response (from model via runtime) --
{
  "id": "rcall-123",
  "choices": [{
    "finish_reason": "function_call",
    "message": {
      "role": "assistant",
      "content": null,
      "function_call": {
        "name": "set_search_mode",
        "arguments": "{\"query\":\"cats\",\"mode\":true}"  <-- NOTICE: mode is boolean inside a JSON string
      }
    }
  }]
}

-- our gateway rejects when we validate function args against declared schema: error "mode must be one of ['fast','accurate'] got true (boolean)"
```

james: Ugh, this is a tricky compat case. The model produced function_call.arguments as a JSON-encoded string where the inner JSON has a boolean instead of the expected enum string. Two problems: stringified args and type mismatch.

kai: Customer says older OpenAI clients sometimes return non-string enum reps depending on model/template. We saw similar with models that implicitly preferred boolean tokens for short answers.

sophie: Can we patch the gateway to coerce common shapes? For example, if schema.enum contains strings and arg type mismatch is boolean, try mapping true->"fast" false->"accurate" as a fallback?

eng-ml: Mapping heuristics risky. Might silently change intent. Need to log and only apply for known model versions or with customer opt-in.

alex: Customer already blocked, and they want a workaround. Quick options: 1) instruct them to pre-validate/normalize user input before calling; 2) ask them to switch SDK flag to return raw function_call object (if available); 3) push hotfix to gateway to attempt non-invasive normalizers + audit log.

sophie: Repro steps for engineering ticket (put this in the bug):
1) Send the request above to our hosted compat endpoint (use model redwood/agent-1).
2) Observe response contains `function_call.arguments` as a JSON string with `mode` boolean.
3) Gateway validation fails with 400; body includes: "InvalidArguments: mode not in enum".
4) Confirm behavior also when the model returns `"mode": "True"` (string) or `"mode": 1` (number).

kai: I added a quick log snippet we can attach to the ticket: 
```js
// gateway normalizer trace log example
{ level: 'warn', route: '/openai/compat', event: 'function-args-type-mismatch', details: { name: 'set_search_mode', arg: 'mode', expected: ['fast','accurate'], observed: 'boolean', raw: '{"query":"cats","mode":true}' } }
```

james: Proposed mitigation plan:
- short-term (hotfix): when arguments are a JSON string, parse it; if type mismatch and value is boolean/number, attempt a minimal deterministic map: boolean true->first enum value, false->second enum value; number->map 0/1->enum index if within bounds. Emit audit log + metric. Only enable for 24-72h as emergency.
- medium term: add explicit compatibility mapper in Redwood Optimize that stores per-model normalizers & a flag customers can opt into. Also expose a telemetry badge in Console to see how often mapper fired.

support-bot: Created ticket SUP-4521 and attached logs. Assigned to eng-runtime with priority P1 (customer-facing). Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-4521

alex: Customer asked for a temporary SDK workaround. Suggested payload for them to send to avoid gateway validation: move function args from string into real object and normalize mode on their side, e.g.:
```json
{"function_call":{"name":"set_search_mode","arguments": {"query":"cats","mode":"fast"}}}
```

sophie: Eng-runtime, can you triage and tell us ETA for a hotfix? If not feasible, we should offer a config toggle for this customer to disable strict validation temporarily.

eng-ml: Will require a short PR to the compat layer + QA run. ETA 2 business days for a controlled hotfix with feature flag.

kai: For the ticket, include unit tests covering: boolean->enum mapping, string-number coercion, and audit logs. Also ensure this only applies when function_call.arguments is stringified JSON; if args are already an object with wrong types, we should not auto-mutate without opt-in.

alex: Thanks all. I'll send the customer the SDK workaround and an ETA note. Keeping thread updated with any hotfix progress. :thumbsup:
